explanation: The statement uses the library's own `HasFiniteMoment` (defined in TauCeti at Basic.lean:439), and Mathlib has no declaration of that name. I found no Mathlib lemma saying that ‖z.1 - z.2‖^2 is integrable under a coupling whose marginals have finite second moments. The proof goes through the library's own `memLp_of_hasFiniteMoment_map`, plus `MemLp.sub` and `memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm`. Together these are more than a one- or two-line instantiation of a single Mathlib result.
